title: Siblings nabbed in Butuan buy-bust; P125,000 ‘shabu’ seized

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— Police arrested two siblings tagged as “high-value individuals” and seized more than P125,000 worth of suspected crystal meth, locally known as “shabu,” during a buy-bust operation in Butuan City on Thursday, Nov. 5. Brig. Gen. Rolindo M. Suguilon, director of Police Regional Office 13 (Caraga), identified the suspects through their aliases, “Al,” 44, and his elder sister, “Shie,” 53.
